topic: CockroachDB table locality and region survival
title: CockroachDB table locality and region survival
brief: Configure CockroachDB table locality and survival goals from actual access and failure requirements.
outcomes: Match regional-by-table, regional-by-row and GLOBAL tables to requests
Verify placement and survival without inventing regional timing evidence
entry: General regional placement, CockroachDB ranges and read contracts.

heading.title: The region model
heading.brief: Distinguish cluster and database regions, primary region, table locality and survival goal using the proposed region labels.

heading.title: Locality by workload
heading.brief: Place shop-owned orders, shared catalogue and regional class sessions; trace current reads, stale reads and writes for each supported locality.

heading.title: A survival goal
heading.brief: Set the chosen goal on an owned pinned deployment and inspect placement; explain quorum, availability and added coordination under the stated failure budget.

heading.title: Failure evidence
heading.brief: Kill a process or group only in the owned environment and verify service behaviour; label simulated region loss and exclude unsupported WAN latency claims.
